protocol.status: frozen before segmentation extraction and mass evaluation
protocol.scope: LeFood development comparison only; all 524 pairs and five existing episodes; no records excluded or relabeled

model.training_data: FoodSeg103 per author's model card; no new dataset download or redistribution
model.preprocessing: EXIF orientation, RGB, resize full image to 512x512 bilinear, ImageNet normalization. Full-frame resize is an explicit transfer choice; author validation used center crop.
model.binary_rule: argmax over 104 classes is nonzero; background=0; no tuned probability or area threshold
model.role: frozen predicted features; not ground-truth masks

protocol.pair_features: concatenate before, after, after-minus-before and after-area / max(before-area, one 512x512 pixel), with ratio clipped to [0,2]
protocol.feature_scaling: mean and standard deviation fitted on the current training partition only; constant-feature scale=1; divide by sqrt(number of features)

segmentation_and_combined_search.training_weights: equal total weight per original food group
segmentation_and_combined_search.selection: minimum group-balanced MAE over original inner folds; ordered first minimum

split_checks: original image file identity before and after
protocol.uncertainty: paired bootstrap of dependency blocks, 2000 resamples, seed 20261003, retaining original group-balanced MAE within each sampled block collection
protocol.gate_caveat: Zero-label gates are provisional until source conflicts are resolved. No claim of human-verified empty-plate performance or validated mask IoU.
protocol.pseudo_label_policy: AI review labels are proposals with provenance and human_review=pending. Never overwrite mass labels; never use AI-produced labels as a gold test set; never train on held-out-image pseudo-labels for these folds. LLM mass guesses are excluded.
protocol.deployment: Retain current demo model until adoption criteria and independent mask/source review support a change. No category pivot.

amendment.timing: After frozen image feature extraction; first mass evaluation stopped at boundary validation before any fold predictions or results.
amendment.reason: Protocol v1 incorrectly treated dependency_block as a disjoint fitting boundary. Original research uses record-level similarity_component purging for fitting and broader group-union dependency blocks for bootstrap uncertainty. One block joins 18 groups and crosses all five original folds. Original research protocol was reread to verify this distinction.
fitting_boundaries: original image SHA256 across either image role
amendment.dependency_block_policy: Report overlap; retain blocks for bootstrap uncertainty. Do not claim independence of these broader blocks across fitting boundaries.
amendment.unchanged: All original episodes, 524 records, 50-label budgets, features, grids, metrics, gates and raw image hashes. No relabeling, exclusion or feature re-extraction.
amendment.interpretation: Retrospective comparison on original purged development folds, not new-serving or dependency-block-held-out generalization.

Segmentation.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.

Combined.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.

mask_quality: No independently verified masks available; IoU and mask confidence are not established.
label_review: No relabeling or exclusions. AI review proposals are not gold labels.
